create_time.Description:
Creation timestamp of a Certificate Map. Timestamp is in RFC3339 UTC "Zulu" format,
accurate to nanoseconds with up to nine fractional digits.
Examples: "2014-10-02T15:01:23Z" and "2014-10-02T15:01:23.045123456Z".

description.Description: A human-readable description of the resource.

effective_labels.Description: All of labels (key/value pairs) present on the resource in GCP, including the labels configured through Terraform, other clients and services.

gclb_targets.Description: A list of target proxies that use this Certificate Map

ip_configs.Description: An IP configuration where this Certificate Map is serving

target_https_proxy.Description:
Proxy name must be in the format projects/*/locations/*/targetHttpsProxies/*.
This field is part of a union field 'target_proxy': Only one of 'targetHttpsProxy' or
'targetSslProxy' may be set.

target_ssl_proxy.Description:
Proxy name must be in the format projects/*/locations/*/targetSslProxies/*.
This field is part of a union field 'target_proxy': Only one of 'targetHttpsProxy' or
'targetSslProxy' may be set.

labels.Description:
Set of labels associated with a Certificate Map resource.


**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_labels' for all of the labels present on the resource.

name.Description:
A user-defined name of the Certificate Map. Certificate Map names must be unique
globally and match the pattern 'projects/*/locations/*/certificateMaps/*'.

terraform_labels.Description:
The combination of labels configured directly on the resource
 and default labels configured on the provider.

update_time.Description:
Update timestamp of a Certificate Map. Timestamp is in RFC3339 UTC "Zulu" format,
accurate to nanoseconds with up to nine fractional digits.
Examples: "2014-10-02T15:01:23Z" and "2014-10-02T15:01:23.045123456Z".
